source_notes: PLA equipment per epoch, recalled from open-source knowledge (no web access this pass). Conventions: epochs 1-7 = 1950-59 / 1960-69 / 1970-79 / 1980-89 / 1990-2004 / 2005-15 / 2016-. entered_service decides the epoch slot. Ground units use speed_kmh + road_range_km; aircraft use speed_kmh (max) + combat_radius_km; ships use speed_kn + displacement_t (full load unless noted). A null designation with a note means the PLA never fielded the role in that epoch -- absence is data. Carryover entries ({carryover_from}) inherit the earlier epoch's stats. Lineage per docs/08: Soviet-derived epochs 1-4, indigenous/networked from epoch 5, fully forked by 6-7. Cross-faction consistency: Soviet-origin systems (Type 59=T-54 derivative, Type 033=Romeo, HQ-2=SA-2, Kilo, Sovremenny, Tor-M1, S-300PMU, Ka-28, Mi-17, Il-78) must match ru faction numbers where ru fields the originals.
